info.title: GitHub Project Manager MCP API
info.description: API for managing GitHub Projects through the Model Context Protocol

post.description: Manage GitHub Projects (v2): create, list, get, update, delete projects; manage readme, fields, views, items; handle templates and link to repos/teams. Use the `action` field to select the operation.

type.description: Type of the field to create — exactly the types GitHub's ProjectV2CustomFieldType accepts

layout.description: Layout of the view — exactly the layouts GitHub's ProjectV2ViewLayout accepts

collaborators.description: The collaborators to grant a role to, one entry per user or team

userLogin.description: Login of the user to grant the role to

teamSlug.description: Slug of the team to grant the role to

role.description: The role to grant — exactly the roles GitHub's ProjectV2Roles accepts

schema.description: Manage GitHub Projects v2 — all project operations

post.description: Manage GitHub Issues: create, list, get, update issues; manage comments and drafts; search with advanced filters; manage sub-issues. Use the `action` field to select the operation.

type.description: The issue type: a native organization issue type (its name or `IT_…` id) or one of bug/feature/enhancement/documentation for the label emulation

blockingIssueId.description: The issue that blocks the given issue (native `blocked by` edge)

dependencyDirection.description: `blocked_by` lists the issues that block this one, `blocking` the ones it blocks

schema.description: Manage GitHub Issues — CRUD, comments, drafts, sub-issues, and search

post.description: Manage Pull Requests: create, get, list, update, merge PRs; list and create reviews. Use the `action` field to select the operation.

action.description: The pull request operation to perform

schema.description: Manage GitHub Pull Requests — create, update, merge, and reviews

post.description: Manage Milestones: create, list, update, delete milestones; get metrics; find overdue and upcoming milestones. Use the `action` field to select the operation.

schema.description: Manage GitHub Milestones — CRUD, metrics, overdue and upcoming tracking

post.description: Manage Sprints: create, list, update sprints; get current sprint; add/remove issues; get metrics and plan. Use the `action` field to select the operation.

projectId.description: Project ID (required for create — sprints are iteration fields on a specific project)

schema.description: Manage Sprints — create, update, plan, add/remove issues, and metrics

post.description: Manage repository Labels: create and list labels. Use the `action` field to select the operation.

schema.description: Manage GitHub Labels — create and list repository labels

post.description: Manage Project Automations: list, get and delete the automation workflows of a GitHub project. Use the `action` field to select the operation.

action.description: The project automation workflow operation to perform

schema.description: Manage Project Automations — list, read and delete the automation workflows of a GitHub project

post.description: Manage Project Iterations: get configuration, current iteration, items; find by date; assign items. Use the `action` field to select the operation.

schema.description: Manage Project Iterations — configuration, current iteration, items, and assignment

post.description: Manage Events: subscribe to project events, get recent events, replay events. Use the `action` field to select the operation.

schema.description: Manage Events — subscribe, get recent events, and replay event history

post.description: Manage project Status Updates: create, list, and get status updates. Use the `action` field to select the operation.

action.description: The status update operation to perform

schema.description: Manage Project Status Updates — create, list, and get status updates

post.description: AI-powered generation: generate/enhance/parse PRDs, add features, get next tasks, analyze complexity, expand tasks, create traceability matrices. Use the `action` field to select the operation.

action.description: The AI generation operation to perform

addToProject.description: Whether to add created issues to the specified projectId

schema.description: AI Generation — PRD generation/enhancement/parsing, feature management, task analysis, task materialization

post.description: AI-powered analysis: enrich issues (single/bulk), triage issues, schedule triaging, suggest labels, detect duplicates, find related issues. Use the `action` field to select the operation.

action.description: The AI analysis operation to perform

schema.description: AI Analysis — issue enrichment, triage, label suggestion, duplicate detection, related issues

post.description: AI-powered planning: calculate capacity, prioritize backlog, assess risk, suggest sprint composition, generate roadmaps and visualizations. Use the `action` field to select the operation.

action.description: The AI planning operation to perform

autoCreate.description: generate_roadmap only: create the milestones in GitHub and assign them to the project's issues. Requires projectId.

schema.description: AI Planning — sprint capacity, backlog prioritization, risk assessment, sprint composition, roadmap generation

post.description: Agent work operations: register agents, checkout/release/complete tasks, send heartbeats, submit/check review state, validate work products, and get handoff context. Use the `action` field to select the operation.

schema.description: Agent Work — register, checkout/release/complete tasks, heartbeat, review, work status

post.description: Agent management: list/deregister agents, activity, work products, budgets (warningFraction or warningThreshold), stale reclaim, smart assignment, workload rebalancing, convergence, and registry cleanup. Use the `action` field to select the operation.

warningThreshold.description: Compatibility alias for warningFraction (0-1 warning threshold)

agentIds.description: Filter reassignment to specific agent IDs

roleFilter.description: Filter reassignment to agents with this role

subtasks.description: Subtasks for decompose_task — PM splits a rejected task into smaller pieces

agentIds.description: Filter smart_assign to specific agent IDs

roleFilter.description: Filter smart_assign to agents with this role

reviewerId.description: Reviewer agent to attribute approve/reject lifecycle actions to, when available

post.description: System operations: health check and project field setup. Use the `action` field to select the operation.

schema.description: System — health check and project field setup

post.description: Discover available compound tools, their actions, and parameters. Always available regardless of group filter.

query.description: Free-text search across tool names and descriptions

schema.description: Discover available tool actions by domain or search query

post.description: Manage GitHub Branch Protection: get, update, and delete a branch's protection rules; list repository branches. Use the `action` field to select the operation.

action.description: The branch protection operation to perform

owner.description: Repository owner (defaults to the configured GITHUB_OWNER)

repo.description: Repository name (defaults to the configured GITHUB_REPO)

branch.description: Branch name — required for get_protection, update_protection, and delete_protection

required_status_checks.description: Required status checks — pass null to disable the requirement (update_protection)

enforce_admins.description: Whether the restrictions also apply to repository admins (update_protection)

required_pull_request_reviews.description: Required pull request review rules — pass null to disable the requirement (update_protection)

restrictions.description: Restrict who can push to the branch — pass null to disable restrictions (update_protection)

schema.description: Manage GitHub Branch Protection — get, update, and delete protection rules; list repository branches

post.description: Manage GitHub Releases: create, list, get, update, delete releases; get the latest release. Use the `action` field to select the operation.

releaseId.description: The release ID (required for get, update, delete)

tag_name.description: The git tag the release is based on (required for create)

target_commitish.description: The branch name or commit SHA the git tag is created from (create only; defaults to the repository's default branch when the tag doesn't already exist)

draft.description: Whether to save the release as a draft (unpublished)

prerelease.description: Whether to identify the release as a prerelease

generate_release_notes.description: Whether GitHub should automatically generate release notes for this release (create only)

schema.description: Manage GitHub Releases — create, list, get, update, delete, and get the latest release

post.description: Manage GitHub Actions Workflows: list workflows, trigger dispatch events, inspect run status and logs, list runs, and cancel runs. Use the `action` field to select the operation.

action.description: The GitHub Actions workflow operation to perform

owner.description: Repository owner (defaults to the configured GITHUB_OWNER)

repo.description: Repository name (defaults to the configured GITHUB_REPO)

limit.description: Results per page (list_workflows, list_runs) — maps to per_page

workflowId.description: Workflow ID or filename (e.g. 'ci.yml') — required for trigger_dispatch and list_runs

ref.description: Git branch or tag ref — required for trigger_dispatch

inputs.description: Input values for the workflow's `workflow_dispatch` trigger (trigger_dispatch)

runId.description: Workflow run ID — required for get_run, get_run_logs, cancel_run

schema.description: Manage GitHub Actions Workflows — list workflows, trigger dispatch events, inspect run status and logs, list runs, and cancel runs
